comparison_contract: Single bounded local decision arm using 16,384 checksum-pinned Cohere Medium 1M 768D vectors, 32 separately opened writer processes, production-representative one-lane writers, production batching, k=10, and a 16-candidate shortlist. V1 terminated before measurement because eight lanes per writer required 256 persisted stripes while the collection provides 64. V2 corrected that topology but terminated before the start barrier because each co-located writer inherited full process-wide CPU/I/O pools and exhausted the 4-vCPU devbox task budget. V3 changes only child-process resource allocation: every writer receives one CPU and two blocking-I/O workers, while the coordinator and measured read path retain normal defaults. Raw artifacts and resource/storage telemetry are terminally validated before inspection. Shadow mode cannot change reads or hits. Promotion requires zero containment failures, p95 survivors <=12, pooled predicted exact-read and byte reductions >=30%, and certificate CPU p95 <=2ms or <=5% of read p95. The arm is ineligible for AWS, 100M-scale, or competitor performance claims.
